svg.aria-label: Component diagram for PPE-next2 – API: request handling and bounded contexts

path.title: Serves published app files from [read-only mount]
Looks up employees and settings via
Gets employees and its Mailer via

g.title: Web server / reverse proxy [Container: Caddy 2.11] Terminates TLS; serves every SPA bundle and published-app file on one origin with cache headers and CSP; proxies /api, /health, /ready and published-app pages to the API.
g.text: bundle and published-app file on one
origin with cache headers and CSP;

g.title: Published app store [Container: Docker volume] Immutable builds of published apps: <profile>/<slug>/<version>/.

HTTP router & access policy [Component: net/http ServeMux, muxstack] Every route registered with an explicit rule (public / signed-in / permission); JWT authenticator, permission authorizer, timeouts, logging.
Health & metrics [Component: Prometheus client] /health, /ready (DB reachable and migrated), /metrics on :9090 (compose network only).
Auth & sessions [Component: user, session, role, security; bcrypt, JWT HS256] Sign-in, 15-min access tokens, HttpOnly refresh sessions, editable roles of permissions, throttling, security events.
Employees [Component: employee, size, employeephoto] Employees, saved sizes, size suggestion from height, photos. Shared kernel for other contexts.
Workwear ordering [Component: catalogue, itemset, order, supplier] Catalogue, item sets, suppliers; orders with immutable snapshot lines, ORDERED → GIVEN, one-time confirmation links.
Company Assets [Component: asset] SIM cards, equipment, furniture; assignments, connection status, assignment forms, signed copies; PIN/PUK sealed.
Personnel files [Component: personnel/document, scan, mrz, colour] Identity documents and copies sealed per person, MRZ checks, kept scans, retention and shredding (special-care data).
g.text: per person, MRZ checks, kept scans,

g.title: AI usage [Component: aiusage] The one client for AI calls: records model, tokens and cost; monthly budget; sealed OpenAI key.
g.text: The one client for AI calls: records

g.title: App Launcher & publishing [Component: launcher, publish-app] Registry of apps, versions and channels; publishes builds; serves each published app's index.html with its CSP.
Administration services [Component: settings, mailtemplate, backup, system, usage, dashboard] Organisation settings, mail templates, backup runs (read-only), system and usage figures, dashboards.
Audit log [Component: audit, tsa] Append-only change events; daily hash seals with trusted timestamps; verification and export.
Cross-context adapters [Component: cmd/api/checkers.go] Composition root: answers the interfaces each context declares, so no context imports another.
